about: How the nightly runs write a lead's location. `forms` names each form the prompt teaches; server/verify-local.mjs reads this file by path and checks the prompt teaches every one.

forms.us-city: City, ST - a US city with its two-letter state
forms.city-country: City, Country - a city outside the US with its country
forms.remote-country: Remote (<country>) - remote, open to one country
forms.remote-us-states: Remote (US - CA/TX/WA) - remote, open only in the US states it names
